findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_print_session · Private data: create_print_session, get_print_session, set_print_only, expire_print_session · Public sink: create_print_session, expire_print_session · Destructive: create_print_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_print_session · Private data: create_print_session, get_print_session, set_print_only, expire_print_session · Public sink: create_print_session, expire_print_session · Destructive: create_print_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
